title: Open Mic Jam Night @ Fitzgerald's Bar & Live Music Venue
event_description: Weekly open mic jam featuring full backline and sound system. Musicians get three songs with up to 15 minutes on stage. Blue room available for next performers to prep. All genres welcome from blues to rock.
venue_address: 437 McCarty Rd Ste 101 San Antonio TX 78216
backline: Line-6 guitar amp Marshall guitar amp keyboard drum kit PA system
event_venue_information:
About Fitzgerald's Bar & Live Music Venue

Fitzgerald's is San Antonio's premier live music venue with a spacious 30ft x 19ft stage and 4000 sq ft bar. This venue has become a cornerstone of the local music scene since opening.

Weekly Music Events

The venue hosts three distinct open mic opportunities every Wednesday creating what they call the Open Mic Trilogy. The R&R Musicians Pro Jam runs from 2-5 PM with a focus on soulful blues and southern rock. The Working Class Open Mic follows from 5-9 PM (all ages welcome with a parent) featuring talent of every kind including comedians. The late-night Open Mic Jam Night kicks off at 9 PM and runs until 1 AM for ages 21 and up.

Live Shows and Tribute Acts

Fridays and Saturdays feature live music from diverse genres including blues metal southern rock and tribute bands covering acts like Judas Priest AC/DC Van Halen Dokken and Ozzy Osbourne. The venue is known for booking both emerging local artists and established national acts.

Venue Features

Features include a full backline for performers professional sound and lighting free parking outdoor patio and a well-stocked bar with domestic premium and craft beers plus mocktail options. Happy hour runs all day Wednesdays with specials on Lone Star wells and select spirits. The venue capacity is 220 people making for an intimate yet energetic atmosphere.

title: Sunday Night Open Mic @ 502 Bar
event_description: Best sounding open mic in San Antonio every Sunday night. Intimate venue with craft beer selection and expertly mixed cocktails. Welcoming atmosphere for musicians of all levels and genres.
event_venue_information:
About 502 Bar

Since 2012 502 Bar has been a staple of San Antonio's live music scene delivering an unforgettable nightlife experience. Open daily from 3 PM to 2 AM this venue spotlights both local favorites and touring acts in an electric atmosphere.

Music and Entertainment

The bar features live music Tuesday through Saturday nights with Sunday reserved for their popular open mic night hosted by Mikey Vibes. The venue has a capacity of 163 people creating an intimate setting where performers and audience connect. Monday nights feature karaoke adding variety to the weekly schedule.

Atmosphere and Amenities

Known for having one of the best sound systems for open mics in the city 502 Bar creates a professional yet welcoming environment. The venue offers a vast and affordable beer selection top-notch service and a very clean environment. Happy hour runs daily from 4-7 PM and reverse happy hour Sunday-Thursday from 9-11 PM with great drink specials. The bar is located in the 281 Bitters area with convenient access.

title: Blues Jam @ The Cove
event_description: Monthly blues jam hosted by the San Antonio Blues Society. First Sunday of every month featuring different SABS member hosts and the best musicians from the area. Backline and PA equipment provided.
venue_address: 606 W Cypress St San Antonio TX 78212
hosts: San Antonio Blues Society rotating hosts
event_venue_information:
About The Cove

The Cove is a unique hybrid destination combining a restaurant Texas beer garden live music venue and even a laundromat and car wash. Known for serving SOL food (Sustainable Organic Local) this venue has become a beloved community gathering spot in San Antonio's Central district.

Live Music Programming

Music is featured Thursday through Sunday with genres spanning blues rock jazz folk Tejano and more. The venue hosts the San Antonio Blues Society jam on the first Sunday of each month from 3:30-6:30 PM featuring rotating hosts and open participation. Live performances happen both inside and on the outdoor beer garden stage. The venue regularly features local and traveling performers from every genre.

Venue Features and Atmosphere

The Cove offers over 50 Texas beers on tap in their expansive beer garden with covered outdoor seating misters and fans for comfort. The family-friendly venue includes a play scape ping-pong tables basketball backboard and dog run. Indoor seating with air conditioning is also available. The laid-back atmosphere welcomes everyone from families to music lovers. Known for their famous fish tacos burgers and commitment to sustainable local food sources.

title: Jazz Jam @ Make My Day Lounge
event_description: Sunday night musician jam sessions featuring jazz and contemporary music. Welcoming atmosphere for jazz musicians to come together and play standards and originals.
event_venue_information:
About Make My Day Lounge

Make My Day Lounge is a music-focused venue located on Nacogdoches Road in San Antonio. The lounge provides a comfortable setting for live music performances and jam sessions.

Music Programming

The venue hosts Sunday night jam sessions from 7:30 PM to 11:30 PM led by Jackie Huddle and Company. These sessions welcome jazz musicians to participate in an informal setting playing standards and contemporary jazz pieces. The Sunday night jams have become a regular meeting point for the local jazz community.

Atmosphere

Make My Day Lounge offers a relaxed lounge atmosphere conducive to both performing and listening to live jazz. The venue caters to music enthusiasts looking for quality jazz performances in an intimate setting.
